project.name: Violet Parfumerie
project.primary_goal: Reduce online fragrance uncertainty through explainable discovery, try-first sampling, feedback loops and a mobile-first buyer journey without pretending the prototype is AI or a live marketplace.

constraints.implementation_style: vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript; static-first where possible; localStorage may simulate prototype preference, trio and feedback state
constraints.visual_completion_requires: rendered mobile and desktop evidence + automated sanity gates + Creative Director screenshot inspection
constraints.system_reality: Recommendation and preference refinement are deterministic rule-based prototype behavior. Do not claim AI, ML, personalization accuracy, real customers, real maisons, fulfilment or conversion impact.
constraints.creative_direction: ChatGPT is the external design brain and Creative Director; UIUX Factory and routed skills own contracts, evidence, repeatable process and QA.
constraints.seller_admin_surface: denser, clearer, utilitarian, explicitly fictional operations
anti_patterns: bottle-card grid as the entire discovery model
fictional redemption presented as a real commercial benefit
seller or admin dashboards styled with the same atmospheric density as buyer discovery
merging substantial visual changes without opened 390px screenshots
